name: The Paseo Club
note: Mediterranean family club: cream stucco and red tile, a fountain courtyard, gyms, studios, spa, locker rooms with sauna and steam, a junior-Olympic pool; navy courts with sky-blue kitchens below stepped stucco terraces.
